name: Progress
description: A bar filling across the sheet: the same track, further along in every column.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4%; top: 38%; width: 92%; height: 24%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); opacity: 0.35; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4%; top: 38%; width: @calc(8 + 84 * @x / @X)%; height: 24%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
